m.aarti.tek: This is the āratī of the elephant-faced Vināyaka, of the leader of the gaṇas, worshipped by gods and sages.
m.aarti.pad1: It is the āratī of the one-tusked, elephant-faced Lord with the moon on his brow; the destroyer of obstacles, a forest of auspicious virtues; the son of Śiva, to whom four-faced Brahmā bows; the destroyer of sorrow and giver of happiness.
m.aarti.pad2: It is the āratī of the master of Ṛddhi and Siddhi, supremely capable; the giver of pure understanding, whose own mind is most pure; the burner of the forest of sins, stainless, whose ways are past knowing; the giver of learning, humility and prosperity.
m.aarti.pad3: It is the āratī of the tawny-eyed one who bears a great trunk; smoke-coloured and pure, with the thunderbolt and the goad in his hands; the big-bellied one who takes away hindrances and calamities; revered by the gods and worthy in every way.
